en.НОВАЯ ПАРТИЯ. Переключай наборы, выбери:
NEW MATCH. Switch sets and choose your hero, mode, opponents, bot skill and board. Tap a hero card to read the full ability. Choose Russian, English, Norwegian Bokmål or Spanish; your language preference is saved.

BOARDS. Marmoreal and Sarpedon support 2–4 players. Sherwood Forest and Yukon support two. Unsuitable boards are hidden for larger matches. Heroes from different sets can play together.

PLACEMENT. Choose the hero’s numbered starting position. For manual placement, confirm that space, then place each sidekick in an empty space sharing a zone with the hero. Tap “Begin battle”.

SCREEN. Swipe your hand sideways below the board. The description on the right scrolls. Player panels sit around the board; tap one or “Discards” to inspect public discards. “Hand” hides cards; “Board ⤢” enlarges the board. The log lists recent events first.

STATUS. Alice’s ↑ +2 means big with +2 attack; ↓ +1 means small with +1 defense. Sinbad’s V shows voyages in his discard. A green + marks an ally. Tokens show whole-number health; one-health sidekicks use individual numbers.

TURN. Take two actions: maneuver, attack or scheme. Maneuver draws a card first, then lets each of your fighters move once. Choose a fighter and a highlighted space. Before the first move, you may BOOST with any card in your hand. Tap “Finish movement” afterward.

COMBAT. Choose a fighter, an attack or versatile card, then a target. Confirm the attack announcement. When defending, choose a card, or tap it again to deselect it and skip defense. The opposing attack stays hidden until defense is chosen. To boost Arthur, select a separate BOOST card before choosing the attack card.

EFFECTS. The combat dialog shows cards, values and damage. “Resolve effects” starts any space, target or card choices. Optional movement can be skipped. Merlin’s Restless Spirits chooses a space in his zone, then an adjacent space: each enemy there takes 2 damage. Prophecy lets you take two of four cards and order the others. A separate dialog shows effect results, including when no legal target exists.

NEW HEROES. After attacking, Robin Hood may move the attacking fighter up to two spaces. This also applies to Outlaws. At the end of his turn, Bigfoot automatically draws an extra card if his zone has no enemies and his deck is not empty.

TEAMS. In 2 vs 2, you and a bot face two bots. Turn order is you → enemy → ally → enemy. Sidekicks continue after their hero is defeated. The team that defeats both enemy heroes wins.

END OF TURN. Discard down to seven cards. The discard is never reshuffled. Each missing draw from an empty deck deals 2 damage to all your fighters. In free-for-all, the last surviving hero wins.

NEW MATCH. Switch sets and choose your hero, mode, opponents, bot skill and board. Tap a hero card to read the full ability. Choose Russian, English, Norwegian Bokmål or Spanish; your language preference is saved.

BOARDS. Marmoreal and Sarpedon support 2–4 players. Sherwood Forest, Yukon and Raptor Paddock support two. Unsuitable boards are hidden for larger matches. Orange arrows in the Paddock restrict movement direction, while attack adjacency remains bidirectional. Heroes from different sets can play together.

PLACEMENT. Choose the hero’s numbered starting position. For manual placement, confirm that space, then place each sidekick in an empty space sharing a zone with the hero. Tap “Begin battle”.

SCREEN. Swipe your hand sideways below the board. The description on the right scrolls. Player panels sit around the board; tap one or “Discards” to inspect public discards. “Hand” hides cards; “Board ⤢” enlarges the board. The log lists recent events first.

STATUS. Alice’s ↑ +2 means big with +2 attack; ↓ +1 means small with +1 defense. Sinbad’s V shows voyages in his discard. A green + marks an ally. Tokens show whole-number health; one-health sidekicks use individual numbers.

TURN. Take two actions: maneuver, attack or scheme. Maneuver draws a card first, then lets each of your fighters move once. Choose a fighter and a highlighted space. Before the first move, you may boost the maneuver with a card that has a printed BOOST value. Sinbad’s six voyages have no BOOST value and cannot be used to boost. Tap “Finish movement” afterward.

COMBAT. Choose a fighter, an attack or versatile card, then a target. Confirm the attack announcement. When defending, choose a card, or tap it again to deselect it and skip defense. The opposing attack stays hidden until defense is chosen. To boost Arthur, select a separate BOOST card before choosing the attack card.

EFFECTS. The combat dialog shows cards, values and damage. “Resolve effects” starts any space, target or card choices. Optional movement can be skipped. Merlin’s Restless Spirits chooses a space in his zone, then an adjacent space: each enemy there takes 2 damage. Prophecy lets you take two of four cards and order the others. A separate dialog shows effect results, including when no legal target exists.

ABILITIES. At the start of Medusa’s turn, choose one enemy in her zone to take 1 damage, or skip the ability. A separate dialog shows the result. Each voyage in Sinbad’s discard gives +1 maneuver to all his fighters. Only voyage card attacks gain the attack bonus; Feint cancels their effect. Boosting with Voyage Home gives both its printed boost and one additional movement space for the voyage newly added to the discard.

NEW HEROES. After attacking, Robin Hood may move the attacking fighter up to two spaces, including an Outlaw. Bigfoot may draw a card at the end of his turn if his zone has no enemies. Bruce Lee may move one space at the end of his turn, and Jeet Kune Do cards grant extra actions.

JURASSIC PARK. Muldoon starts with eight traps for the entire match. At the start of his turn, he may place a trap in an empty space in his zone. An enemy entering it stops and takes 1 damage; the trap is removed and Muldoon draws a card. Allies pass freely. The Raptors are three heroes with 7 health each: losing one does not end the match. Each of your other Raptors adjacent to the target gives +1 attack. The player panel shows all three health totals.

TEAMS. In 2 vs 2, you and a bot face two bots. Turn order is you → enemy → ally → enemy. Sidekicks continue after their hero is defeated. The team that defeats both enemy heroes wins.

END OF TURN. Discard down to seven cards. The discard is never reshuffled. Each missing draw from an empty deck deals 2 damage to all your fighters. In free-for-all, the last surviving hero wins.

en.НОВАЯ ПАРТИЯ. Переключай наборы, выбери:
NEW MATCH. Switch sets and choose your hero, mode, opponents, bot skill and board. Tap a hero card to read the full ability. Choose Russian, English, Norwegian Bokmål or Spanish; your language preference is saved.

BOARDS. Marmoreal, Sarpedon, Soho and Baskerville Manor support 2–4 players. Sherwood Forest, Yukon, Raptor Paddock, Manila and Tsing Shan Monastery support two. Unsuitable boards are hidden for larger matches. Orange arrows in the Paddock restrict movement direction. The Manor’s secret passages connect marked spaces for movement, but not for attacks. Heroes from different sets can play together.

PLACEMENT. Choose the hero’s numbered starting position. For manual placement, confirm that space, then place each sidekick in an empty space sharing a zone with the hero. Tap “Begin battle”.

SCREEN. Swipe your hand sideways below the board. The description on the right scrolls. Player panels sit around the board; tap one or “Discards” to inspect public discards. “Hand” hides cards; “Board ⤢” enlarges the board. The log lists recent events first.

STATUS. Alice’s ↑ +2 means big with +2 attack; ↓ +1 means small with +1 defense. Sinbad’s V shows voyages in his discard. A green + marks an ally. Tokens show whole-number health; one-health sidekicks use individual numbers.

TURN. Take two actions: maneuver, attack or scheme. Maneuver draws a card first, then lets each of your fighters move once. Choose a fighter and a highlighted space. Before the first move, you may boost the maneuver with a card that has a printed BOOST value. Sinbad’s six voyages have no BOOST value and cannot be used to boost. Tap “Finish movement” afterward.

COMBAT. Choose a fighter, an attack or versatile card, then a target. Confirm the attack announcement. When defending, choose a card, or tap it again to deselect it and skip defense. The opposing attack stays hidden until defense is chosen. To boost Arthur, select a separate BOOST card before choosing the attack card.

EFFECTS. The combat dialog shows cards, values and damage. “Resolve effects” starts any space, target or card choices. Optional movement can be skipped. Merlin’s Restless Spirits chooses a space in his zone, then an adjacent space: each enemy there takes 2 damage. Prophecy lets you take two of four cards and order the others. A separate dialog shows effect results, including when no legal target exists.

VIEWING HANDS. Cards that let you look at an opponent’s hand open a separate window showing every card in it. Tap an image to enlarge it and read the complete rules. Return to the revealed hand and tap “Finish viewing” to continue combat. If an effect requires you to choose a card to discard or shuffle into a deck, tap its selection button. Viewing a card does not discard it. Ali’s Hard to Be Humble reveals the hand only in Butterfly stance, during combat, if its effect is not canceled.

ABILITIES. At the start of Medusa’s turn, choose one enemy in her zone to take 1 damage, or skip the ability. A separate dialog shows the result. Each voyage in Sinbad’s discard gives +1 maneuver to all his fighters. Only voyage card attacks gain the attack bonus; Feint cancels their effect. Boosting with Voyage Home gives both its printed boost and one additional movement space for the voyage newly added to the discard.

NEW HEROES. After attacking, Robin Hood may move the attacking fighter up to two spaces, including an Outlaw. Bigfoot may draw a card at the end of his turn if his zone has no enemies. Bruce Lee may move one space at the end of his turn, and Jeet Kune Do cards grant extra actions.

JURASSIC PARK. Muldoon starts with eight traps for the entire match. At the start of his turn, he may place a trap in an empty space in his zone. An enemy entering it stops and takes 1 damage; the trap is removed and Muldoon draws a card. Allies pass freely. The Raptors are three heroes with 7 health each: losing one does not end the match. Each of your other Raptors adjacent to the target gives +1 attack. The player panel shows all three health totals.

MULDOON’S TRAPS. For Call for Backup, first choose two different effects. Traps placed by this card may be placed anywhere on the board, including outside Muldoon’s zone. Tap up to three empty spaces containing no fighters or tokens. You may stop early. The card uses the remaining traps in your supply and does not return used traps. The normal start-of-turn ability remains limited to Muldoon’s zone. Remote Detonation requires a trap in a living InGen worker’s zone; removing the trap draws a card.

MUHAMMAD ALI. Starts in Butterfly stance and can attack from up to two spaces away. Bee stance gives +2 attack after during-combat card effects. Ali changes stance after winning an attack; his current stance appears beside his fighter and in the description.

COBBLE & FOG. At the start of his turn, Dracula may deal 1 damage to any adjacent fighter and draw a card. Holmes and Watson cards cannot be canceled. Jekyll chooses a form at the start of his turn; Hyde takes 1 damage when maneuvering, and form-specific cards require the matching form. Invisible Man places three fog tokens: fog gives him +1 defense, and he can move between fog spaces. Separate dialogs present choices for unusual effects.

BUFFY. Choose Buffy’s sidekick in the menu: Giles or Xander. Their five cards are added to the deck; the other sidekick does not participate in that match. Buffy can move through enemies. After Angel or Faith loses an attack, draw a card. Spike places shadow tokens, and Willow can become Dark Willow. Shadow tokens, Willow’s form and the chosen sidekick are saved with the match. Sunnydale High and The Bronze support 2–4 players.

TEAMS. In 2 vs 2, you and a bot face two bots. Turn order is you → enemy → ally → enemy. Sidekicks continue after their hero is defeated. The team that defeats both enemy heroes wins.

END OF TURN. Discard down to seven cards. The discard is never reshuffled. Each missing draw from an empty deck deals 2 damage to all your fighters. In free-for-all, the last surviving hero wins.

Oransje piler i innhegningen begrenser bevegelsesretningen, men nabofelt for angrep gjelder begge veier. Helter fra ulike sett kan spille sammen.

PLASSERING. Velg heltens nummererte startposisjon. Ved manuell plassering bekrefter du startfeltet, og plasserer hver hjelper på et ledig felt i en felles sone med helten. Trykk «Start kamp».

SKJERM. Sveip hånden sidelengs under brettet. Beskrivelsen til høyre kan rulles. Spillerpaneler står langs brettet; trykk på et panel eller «Kastebunker» for å se åpne kastebunker. «Hånd» skjuler kort, og «Brett ⤢» forstørrer brettet. Loggen viser nyeste hendelser først.

TUR. Utfør to handlinger: manøver, angrep eller plan. En manøver trekker først et kort, og lar deretter hver av krigerne dine flytte én gang. Velg en kriger og et markert felt. KAMP. Velg kriger, angrepskort eller allsidig kort, og deretter mål. Bekreft angrepsmeldingen. Ved forsvar velger du et kort, eller trykker på det igjen for å fjerne valget og hoppe over forsvar. nb.ЛОВУШКИ МАЛДУНА. У «Вызвать подкрепление: MULDOONS FELLER. Med Tilkall forsterkninger velger du først to ulike effekter. Feller fra dette kortet kan plasseres hvor som helst på brettet, også utenfor Muldoons sone. Trykk på opptil tre ledige felt uten krigere eller brikker. Du kan stoppe før du har valgt tre. Buffy kan bevege seg gjennom fiender. Trekk et kort etter at Angel eller Faith taper et angrep. Spike plasserer skyggebrikker, og Willow kan bli Mørke Willow. nb.НОВАЯ ПАРТИЯ. Переключай наборы, выбери:
NYTT PARTI. Bytt sett og velg helt, modus, motstandere, nivå og brett. Trykk på et heltekort for å lese hele evnen. Velg russisk, engelsk, norsk bokmål eller spansk. Språkvalget lagres.

BRETT. Marmoreal, Sarpedon, Soho og Baskerville-godset støtter 2–4 spillere. Sherwoodskogen, Yukon, Raptorinnhegningen, Manila og Tsing Shan-klosteret støtter to. Brett som ikke passer, skjules i større partier. Oransje piler i innhegningen begrenser bevegelsesretningen. Godsets hemmelige ganger forbinder markerte felt for bevegelse, men ikke for angrep. Helter fra ulike sett kan spille sammen.

PLASSERING. Velg heltens nummererte startposisjon. Ved manuell plassering bekrefter du startfeltet, og plasserer hver hjelper på et ledig felt i en felles sone med helten. Trykk «Start kamp».

SKJERM. Sveip hånden sidelengs under brettet. Beskrivelsen til høyre kan rulles. Spillerpaneler står langs brettet; trykk på et panel eller «Kastebunker» for å se åpne kastebunker. «Hånd» skjuler kort, og «Brett ⤢» forstørrer brettet. Loggen viser nyeste hendelser først.

TILSTAND. Alices ↑ +2 betyr stor med +2 i angrep; ↓ +1 betyr liten med +1 i forsvar. Sinbads V viser reiser i kastebunken. Et grønt + markerer en alliert. Brikker viser liv som heltall; hjelpere med ett liv har egne numre.

TUR. Utfør to handlinger: manøver, angrep eller plan. En manøver trekker først et kort, og lar deretter hver av krigerne dine flytte én gang. Velg en kriger og et markert felt. Før første bevegelse kan du forsterke manøveren med et kort som har en trykt BOOST-verdi. Sinbads seks reiser har ingen BOOST-verdi og kan ikke brukes til forsterkning. Trykk til slutt «Avslutt bevegelse».

KAMP. Velg kriger, angrepskort eller allsidig kort, og deretter mål. Bekreft angrepsmeldingen. Ved forsvar velger du et kort, eller trykker på det igjen for å fjerne valget og hoppe over forsvar. Fiendens angrep er skjult til forsvaret er valgt. For å forsterke Arthur velger du et eget BOOST-kort før angrepskortet.

EFFEKTER. Kampvinduet viser kort, verdier og skade. «Utfør effekter» starter valg av felt, mål eller kort. Valgfri bevegelse kan hoppes over. Merlins Rastløse ånder velger et felt i sonen hans og deretter et tilstøtende felt: hver fiende der tar 2 skade. Profeti lar deg ta to av fire kort og ordne resten. Et eget vindu viser resultatet, også når det ikke finnes et lovlig mål.

SE PÅ HÅNDEN. Kort som lar deg se på motstanderens hånd, åpner et eget vindu som viser alle kortene. Trykk på et bilde for å forstørre det og lese hele regelteksten. Gå tilbake til den viste hånden og trykk «Avslutt visning» for å fortsette kampen. Hvis en effekt krever at du velger et kort som skal kastes eller stokkes inn i en kortstokk, trykker du på kortets valgknapp. Visning av et kort kaster det ikke. Alis Vanskelig å være ydmyk viser hånden bare i sommerfuglstillingen, under kamp, hvis effekten ikke oppheves.

EVNER. På starten av Medusas tur velger du én fiende i sonen hennes som tar 1 skade, eller hopper over evnen. Et eget vindu viser resultatet. Hver reise i Sinbads kastebunke gir +1 manøver til alle krigerne hans. Bare angrep med reisekort får angrepsbonusen; Finte opphever effekten deres. BOOST med Hjemreisen gir både den trykte forsterkningen og ett ekstra bevegelsesfelt for den nye reisen i kastebunken.

NYE HELTER. Etter at du har angrepet, kan Robin Hood flytte den angripende krigeren opptil to felt, også en fredløs. Bigfoot kan trekke et kort på slutten av turen hvis sonen hans er uten fiender. Bruce Lee kan flytte ett felt på slutten av turen, og Jeet Kune Do-kort gir ekstra handlinger.

JURASSIC PARK. Muldoon starter med åtte feller for hele partiet. På starten av turen kan han plassere en felle på et ledig felt i sonen sin. En fiende som går inn i fellen, stopper og tar 1 skade; fellen fjernes og Muldoon trekker et kort. Allierte passerer fritt. Raptorene er tre helter med 7 liv hver: partiet slutter ikke når én beseires. Hver av dine andre raptorer ved siden av målet gir +1 i angrep. Spillerpanelet viser livet til alle tre.

MULDOONS FELLER. Med Tilkall forsterkninger velger du først to ulike effekter. Feller fra dette kortet kan plasseres hvor som helst på brettet, også utenfor Muldoons sone. Trykk på opptil tre ledige felt uten krigere eller brikker. Du kan stoppe før du har valgt tre. Kortet bruker de gjenværende fellene i beholdningen og gir ikke tilbake brukte feller. Den vanlige evnen på starten av turen er fortsatt begrenset til Muldoons sone. Fjernutløst sprengning krever en felle i sonen til en levende InGen-arbeider. Når fellen fjernes, trekker du et kort.

MUHAMMAD ALI. Starter i sommerfuglstillingen og kan angripe på opptil to felts avstand. Biestillingen gir +2 i angrep etter korteffekter som skjer under kamp. Ali bytter stilling etter å ha vunnet et angrep. Gjeldende stilling vises ved krigeren og i beskrivelsen.

BROSTEIN OG TÅKE. På starten av turen kan Dracula gi 1 skade til en valgfri tilstøtende kriger og trekke et kort. Holmes- og Watson-kort kan ikke oppheves. Jekyll velger skikkelse på starten av turen. Hyde tar 1 skade ved manøver, og kort merket med en skikkelse krever den tilsvarende skikkelsen. Den usynlige mannen plasserer tre tåkebrikker: tåke gir ham +1 i forsvar, og han kan flytte mellom tåkefelt. Egne vinduer viser valg for uvanlige effekter.

BUFFY. Velg Buffys hjelper i menyen: Giles eller Xander. Hjelperens fem kort legges til kortstokken; den andre hjelperen deltar ikke i dette partiet. Buffy kan bevege seg gjennom fiender. Trekk et kort etter at Angel eller Faith taper et angrep. Spike plasserer skyggebrikker, og Willow kan bli Mørke Willow. Skyggebrikker, Willows skikkelse og valgt hjelper lagres med partiet. Sunnydale videregående skole og The Bronze støtter 2–4 spillere.

LAG. I 2 mot 2 spiller du med en datastyrt lagkamerat mot to datamotstandere. Turrekkefølgen er du → fiende → alliert → fiende. Hjelpere fortsetter etter at helten er beseiret. Laget som beseirer begge fiendtlige helter, vinner.

TURSLUTT. Kast kort til du har sju igjen. Kastebunken stokkes aldri inn igjen. Hvert kort du ikke kan trekke fra en tom kortstokk, gir 2 skade til alle krigerne dine. I alle mot alle vinner den siste overlevende helten.

Meldinger venter på bekreftelse. Datamotstanderne venter mens du ser på loggen, kastebunker eller kort. Automatisk lagring tar med det aktive valget. Velg BOOST fra korteffekter etter at kortet er avslørt. Enkelte kortsøk er automatiske. Datamotstanderne bruker tre heuristiske nivåer.

Uoffisielt fanspill til personlig bruk. Originalkortene er på engelsk; oversatte beskrivelser vises separat. Unmatched og komponentbildene tilhører rettighetshaverne.

nb.Особых правил поля нет. Связанные линией: Dette brettet har ingen spesialregler. Felt forbundet med en linje er naboer; like farger danner soner.

es.НОВАЯ ПАРТИЯ. Переключай наборы, выбери:
NUEVA PARTIDA. Cambia de conjunto y elige héroe, modo, rivales, nivel de los bots y tablero. Pulsa un héroe para leer su habilidad completa. Puedes elegir ruso, inglés, noruego bokmål o español; el idioma se guarda.

TABLEROS. Marmóreo y Sarpedón admiten 2–4 jugadores. El Bosque de Sherwood, Yukón y el Recinto de los raptores son para dos. Los tableros no válidos se ocultan en partidas más grandes. Las flechas naranjas del Recinto limitan la dirección del movimiento, pero las casillas siguen siendo adyacentes en ambos sentidos para atacar. Puedes combinar héroes de distintos conjuntos.

COLOCACIÓN. Elige la posición inicial numerada del héroe. En colocación manual confirma esa casilla y coloca a cada ayudante en una casilla vacía que comparta zona con el héroe. Pulsa «Comenzar batalla».

PANTALLA. Desliza la mano bajo el tablero. La descripción de la derecha se desplaza. Los paneles de jugadores están alrededor del tablero; pulsa uno o «Descartes» para consultar los descartes públicos. «Mano» oculta las cartas y «Tablero ⤢» amplía el tablero. El registro muestra primero los eventos recientes.

ESTADOS. ↑ +2 de Alicia indica tamaño grande y +2 al ataque; ↓ +1 indica tamaño pequeño y +1 a la defensa. La V de Simbad muestra sus travesías descartadas. Un + verde señala a un aliado. Las fichas muestran vida entera; los ayudantes de un punto de vida llevan números individuales.

TURNO. Realiza dos acciones: maniobra, ataque o ardid. La maniobra primero roba una carta y después permite mover una vez a cada combatiente tuyo. Elige una figura y una casilla resaltada. Antes del primer movimiento puedes potenciar la maniobra con una carta que tenga un valor de BOOST impreso. Las seis travesías de Simbad no tienen BOOST y no se pueden usar para potenciar. Al terminar pulsa «Terminar movimiento».

COMBATE. Elige combatiente, carta de ataque o versátil y objetivo. Confirma el anuncio del ataque. Para defender elige una carta, o vuelve a pulsarla para deseleccionarla y pasar la defensa. El ataque rival está oculto hasta elegir defensa. Para potenciar a Arturo elige primero otra carta para BOOST y luego la carta de ataque.

EFECTOS. La ventana de combate muestra cartas, valores y daño. «Resolver efectos» inicia la elección de casillas, objetivos o cartas. Puedes omitir el movimiento opcional. Los Espíritus inquietos de Merlín eligen una casilla de su zona y otra adyacente: cada enemigo allí recibe 2 de daño. Profecía permite tomar dos de cuatro cartas y ordenar las restantes. Otra ventana muestra los resultados, incluida la ausencia de un objetivo válido.

HABILIDADES. Al inicio del turno de Medusa elige un enemigo de su zona para infligirle 1 de daño, o pasa la habilidad. Otra ventana muestra el resultado. Cada travesía en el descarte de Simbad da +1 a la maniobra de todos sus combatientes. Solo los ataques con cartas de travesía obtienen la bonificación al ataque; Finta cancela su efecto. Potenciar con Travesía a casa da tanto su BOOST impreso como una casilla adicional de movimiento por la nueva travesía añadida al descarte.

NUEVOS HÉROES. Después de atacar Robin Hood puede mover al atacante hasta dos casillas, incluidos los forajidos. Bigfoot puede robar una carta al final de su turno si no hay enemigos en su zona. Bruce Lee puede moverse una casilla al final de su turno, y las cartas de Jeet Kune Do otorgan acciones adicionales.

JURASSIC PARK. Muldoon empieza con ocho trampas para toda la partida. Al inicio de su turno puede colocar una en una casilla vacía de su zona. Un enemigo que entra se detiene y recibe 1 de daño; la trampa se retira y Muldoon roba una carta. Los aliados pasan libremente. Los raptores son tres héroes con 7 de vida cada uno: perder uno no termina la partida. Cada uno de tus otros raptores adyacentes al objetivo da +1 al ataque. El panel del jugador muestra la vida de los tres.

EQUIPOS. En 2 contra 2 juegas con un bot contra otros dos. El orden es tú → enemigo → aliado → enemigo. Los ayudantes siguen tras la derrota de su héroe. Gana el equipo que derrota a ambos héroes enemigos.

FIN DEL TURNO. Descarta hasta tener siete cartas. El descarte no se vuelve a barajar. Cada robo que falta de un mazo vacío inflige 2 de daño a todos tus combatientes. En todos contra todos gana el último héroe superviviente.

Los avisos esperan confirmación. Los bots esperan mientras consultas el registro, los descartes o las cartas. El autoguardado incluye la elección actual. Elige el BOOST del efecto tras revelar la carta. Algunas búsquedas son automáticas. Los bots usan tres niveles heurísticos.

Si un efecto exige elegir una carta para descartarla o barajarla en un mazo, pulsa su botón de selección. Ver una carta no la descarta. Cuesta ser humilde de Ali revela la mano solo en la postura Mariposa, durante el combate, si no se cancela su efecto.
es.ЛОВУШКИ МАЛДУНА. У «Вызвать подкрепление: TRAMPAS DE MULDOON. Con Pedir refuerzos, primero elige dos efectos distintos. Esta carta permite colocar trampas en cualquier lugar del tablero, incluso fuera de la zona de Muldoon. Pulsa hasta tres casillas vacías sin combatientes ni fichas. Puedes detenerte antes. La carta usa las trampas restantes de tu reserva y no recupera las usadas. La habilidad habitual del inicio del turno sigue limitada a la zona de Muldoon. Detonación remota requiere una trampa en la zona de un trabajador vivo de InGen; retirar la trampa permite robar una carta.
es.БАФФИ. В меню выбери одного помощника Ба: BUFFY. Elige al ayudante de Buffy en el menú: Giles o Xander. Sus cinco cartas se añaden al mazo; el otro ayudante no participa en esa partida. Buffy puede atravesar enemigos. Después de que Angel o Faith pierdan un ataque, roba una carta. Spike coloca fichas de sombra y Willow puede convertirse en Willow Oscura. Las fichas de sombra, la forma de Willow y el ayudante elegido se guardan con la partida. El Instituto de Sunnydale y El Bronze admiten 2–4 jugadores.
es.НОВАЯ ПАРТИЯ. Переключай наборы, выбери:
NUEVA PARTIDA. Cambia de conjunto y elige héroe, modo, rivales, nivel de los bots y tablero. Pulsa un héroe para leer su habilidad completa. Puedes elegir ruso, inglés, noruego bokmål o español; el idioma se guarda.

TABLEROS. Marmóreo, Sarpedón, Soho y la Mansión Baskerville admiten 2–4 jugadores. El Bosque de Sherwood, Yukón, el Recinto de los raptores, Manila y el Monasterio de Tsing Shan son para dos. Los tableros no válidos se ocultan en partidas más grandes. Las flechas naranjas del Recinto limitan la dirección del movimiento. Los pasadizos secretos de la Mansión conectan las casillas marcadas para moverse, pero no para atacar. Puedes combinar héroes de distintos conjuntos.

COLOCACIÓN. Elige la posición inicial numerada del héroe. En colocación manual confirma esa casilla y coloca a cada ayudante en una casilla vacía que comparta zona con el héroe. Pulsa «Comenzar batalla».

PANTALLA. Desliza la mano bajo el tablero. La descripción de la derecha se desplaza. Los paneles de jugadores están alrededor del tablero; pulsa uno o «Descartes» para consultar los descartes públicos. «Mano» oculta las cartas y «Tablero ⤢» amplía el tablero. El registro muestra primero los eventos recientes.

ESTADOS. ↑ +2 de Alicia indica tamaño grande y +2 al ataque; ↓ +1 indica tamaño pequeño y +1 a la defensa. La V de Simbad muestra sus travesías descartadas. Un + verde señala a un aliado. Las fichas muestran vida entera; los ayudantes de un punto de vida llevan números individuales.

TURNO. Realiza dos acciones: maniobra, ataque o ardid. La maniobra primero roba una carta y después permite mover una vez a cada combatiente tuyo. Elige una figura y una casilla resaltada. Antes del primer movimiento puedes potenciar la maniobra con una carta que tenga un valor de BOOST impreso. Las seis travesías de Simbad no tienen BOOST y no se pueden usar para potenciar. Al terminar pulsa «Terminar movimiento».

COMBATE. Elige combatiente, carta de ataque o versátil y objetivo. Confirma el anuncio del ataque. Para defender elige una carta, o vuelve a pulsarla para deseleccionarla y pasar la defensa. El ataque rival está oculto hasta elegir defensa. Para potenciar a Arturo elige primero otra carta para BOOST y luego la carta de ataque.

EFECTOS. La ventana de combate muestra cartas, valores y daño. «Resolver efectos» inicia la elección de casillas, objetivos o cartas. Puedes omitir el movimiento opcional. Los Espíritus inquietos de Merlín eligen una casilla de su zona y otra adyacente: cada enemigo allí recibe 2 de daño. Profecía permite tomar dos de cuatro cartas y ordenar las restantes. Otra ventana muestra los resultados, incluida la ausencia de un objetivo válido.

VER MANOS. Las cartas que permiten mirar la mano rival abren una ventana con todas sus cartas. Pulsa una imagen para ampliarla y leer las reglas completas. Vuelve a la mano revelada y pulsa «Terminar de ver» para continuar el combate. Si un efecto exige elegir una carta para descartarla o barajarla en un mazo, pulsa su botón de selección. Ver una carta no la descarta. Cuesta ser humilde de Ali revela la mano solo en la postura Mariposa, durante el combate, si no se cancela su efecto.

HABILIDADES. Al inicio del turno de Medusa elige un enemigo de su zona para infligirle 1 de daño, o pasa la habilidad. Otra ventana muestra el resultado. Cada travesía en el descarte de Simbad da +1 a la maniobra de todos sus combatientes. Solo los ataques con cartas de travesía obtienen la bonificación al ataque; Finta cancela su efecto. Potenciar con Travesía a casa da tanto su BOOST impreso como una casilla adicional de movimiento por la nueva travesía añadida al descarte.

NUEVOS HÉROES. Después de atacar Robin Hood puede mover al atacante hasta dos casillas, incluidos los forajidos. Bigfoot puede robar una carta al final de su turno si no hay enemigos en su zona. Bruce Lee puede moverse una casilla al final de su turno, y las cartas de Jeet Kune Do otorgan acciones adicionales.

JURASSIC PARK. Muldoon empieza con ocho trampas para toda la partida. Al inicio de su turno puede colocar una en una casilla vacía de su zona. Un enemigo que entra se detiene y recibe 1 de daño; la trampa se retira y Muldoon roba una carta. Los aliados pasan libremente. Los raptores son tres héroes con 7 de vida cada uno: perder uno no termina la partida. Cada uno de tus otros raptores adyacentes al objetivo da +1 al ataque. El panel del jugador muestra la vida de los tres.

TRAMPAS DE MULDOON. Con Pedir refuerzos, primero elige dos efectos distintos. Esta carta permite colocar trampas en cualquier lugar del tablero, incluso fuera de la zona de Muldoon. Pulsa hasta tres casillas vacías sin combatientes ni fichas. Puedes detenerte antes. La carta usa las trampas restantes de tu reserva y no recupera las usadas. La habilidad habitual del inicio del turno sigue limitada a la zona de Muldoon. Detonación remota requiere una trampa en la zona de un trabajador vivo de InGen; retirar la trampa permite robar una carta.

MUHAMMAD ALI. Empieza en la postura Mariposa y puede atacar hasta a dos casillas de distancia. La postura Abeja da +2 al ataque tras los efectos de cartas que se resuelven durante el combate. Ali cambia de postura después de ganar un ataque; su postura actual aparece junto a su figura y en la descripción.

ADOQUINES Y NIEBLA. Al inicio de su turno Drácula puede infligir 1 de daño a cualquier combatiente adyacente y robar una carta. No se pueden cancelar las cartas de Holmes y Watson. Jekyll elige una forma al inicio de su turno; Hyde recibe 1 de daño al realizar una maniobra, y las cartas de cada forma solo se pueden jugar en ella. El Hombre Invisible coloca tres fichas de niebla: la niebla le da +1 a la defensa y le permite moverse entre casillas con niebla. Ventanas independientes muestran las elecciones de los efectos inusuales.

BUFFY. Elige al ayudante de Buffy en el menú: Giles o Xander. Sus cinco cartas se añaden al mazo; el otro ayudante no participa en esa partida. Buffy puede atravesar enemigos. Después de que Angel o Faith pierdan un ataque, roba una carta. Spike coloca fichas de sombra y Willow puede convertirse en Willow Oscura. Las fichas de sombra, la forma de Willow y el ayudante elegido se guardan con la partida. El Instituto de Sunnydale y El Bronze admiten 2–4 jugadores.

EQUIPOS. En 2 contra 2 juegas con un bot contra otros dos. El orden es tú → enemigo → aliado → enemigo. Los ayudantes siguen tras la derrota de su héroe. Gana el equipo que derrota a ambos héroes enemigos.

FIN DEL TURNO. Descarta hasta tener siete cartas. El descarte no se vuelve a barajar. Cada robo que falta de un mazo vacío inflige 2 de daño a todos tus combatientes. En todos contra todos gana el último héroe superviviente.

Los avisos esperan confirmación. Los bots esperan mientras consultas el registro, los descartes o las cartas. El autoguardado incluye la elección actual. Elige el BOOST del efecto tras revelar la carta. Algunas búsquedas son automáticas. Los bots usan tres niveles heurísticos.

es.Скрежет зубов, раздирание плоти: El crujir de dientes, el desgarro de la carne
es.Мир, когда-то принадлежавший им: Un mundo que alguna vez fue suyo
es.Во время боя: можете увеличить или умень: Durante el combate: puedes aumentar o disminuir el valor de esta carta en 1. Después del combate: si su valor coincide con la carta de tu oponente, roba 1 carta e inflige 2 daños al luchador contrario.

es.После боя: нанесите урон, равный BOOST к: Después del combate: inflige daño igual al valor de BOOST de la carta de tu oponente a un luchador contrario adyacente a un Pájaro que no está en el combate.
es.Выберите вражеского бойца. Ближайшая к н: Elige un luchador contrario. El pájaro más cercano a ellos los ataca con ENJAMBRE. Luego, si has ganado un combate este turno, ganas 1 acción.
es.Во время боя: увеличьте значение этой ка: Durante el combate: suma 1 al valor de esta carta por cada Pájaro adyacente al luchador contrario.
es.Шесть Птиц, у каждой 2 здоровья. При нач: Seis pájaros, cada uno con 2 de salud. Durante la instalación, coloque cada pájaro adicional junto a otro pájaro. Después de tu primer ataque de cada acción, puedes descartar 1 carta para realizar un ataque adicional de ENJAMBRE. Durante SWARM, roba 1 carta; su valor es igual al número de pájaros adyacentes al luchador contrario.
es.В начале своего хода можете сбросить эту: Puedes descartar esta carta al comienzo de tu turno para intercambiar los espacios de cabeza y cola del alce. Inmediatamente: cancela todos los efectos de la carta de tu oponente.
es.Возьмите 1 карту. Каждый противник может: Roba 1 carta. Cada oponente puede colocar a su héroe adyacente al Alce. Luego inflige 2 daños a cada héroe contrario que no esté adyacente al alce.
es.Переместите Лося на расстояние до 5 клет: Mueve el alce hasta 5 espacios, a través de luchadores contrarios.
es.После боя: если вы проиграли, противник: Después del combate: Si perdiste, tu oponente descarta 1 carta. De lo contrario, inflige 1 daño al luchador contrario.
es.Во время боя: если Лось не делит ни одно: Durante el combate: si el Alce no comparte zonas con los espacios en los que comenzó, el valor de esta carta es 6.
es.Можете разыграть эту карту лицом вверх к: Puedes jugar esta carta boca arriba como un ataque a distancia. Inmediatamente: coloca el alce adyacente al luchador contrario.
es.После боя: возьмите 1 карту. Если вы выи: Después del combate: Roba 1 carta. Si ganaste, dibuja 2 en su lugar.
es.Во время боя: возьмите 1 карту. Противни: Durante el combate: Roba 1 carta. Tu oponente mueve el Alce 1 espacio. Si no pueden, puedes IMPULSAR esta tarjeta.
es.Немедленно: вражеские бойцы не могут пок: Inmediatamente: los luchadores contrarios no pueden abandonar sus espacios este turno. Después del combate: Si ganaste, roba 2 cartas.
es.После боя: если вы выиграли, выберите од: Después del combate: Si ganaste, elige un luchador en el combate y muévelo hasta 2 espacios.
es.Немедленно: если противник, участвующий: Inmediatamente: si el luchador contrario está adyacente a la cola del alce, gana 1 acción. Después del combate: Mueve el Alce hasta 4 espacios.
es.Немедленно: игнорируйте значение карты п: Inmediatamente: ignora el valor de la carta de tu oponente. Si el luchador contrario está adyacente a la cola del alce, también cancela sus efectos.
es.Лось — огромный боец. Он атакует только: El alce es un gran luchador. Sólo puede atacar a los combatientes enemigos adyacentes. Al moverse, su cabeza no puede entrar en el espacio de su cola. Durante el combate al atacar, si el luchador contrario está adyacente a su cabeza, suma 2 al valor de tu carta.
es.Призовите 1 Щупальце на свободную клетку: Invoca 1 tentáculo en la zona del Kraken. Si el Kraken no comparte zonas con los luchadores contrarios, roba 2 cartas.
es.Во время боя: уменьшите весь боевой урон: Durante el combate: Reduce a la mitad el daño de combate infligido al Kraken, redondeado hacia arriba. Después del combate: Si el Kraken recibió 2 o menos daños, finaliza el turno.
es.После боя: переместите каждого бойца, вк: Después del combate: Mueve a cada luchador hasta 1 espacio, incluidos los luchadores contrarios.
es.Во время боя: если хотя бы один другой д: Durante el combate: si otro luchador amigo está adyacente al luchador contrario, puedes IMPULSAR esta carta.
es.После боя: возьмите 1 карту. Если хотя б: Después del combate: Roba 1 carta. Si otro combatiente amigo está adyacente al combatiente contrario, roba 2 en su lugar.
es.Во время боя: значение этой карты равно: Durante el combate: el valor de esta carta es igual al número de zonas diferentes en las que se encuentran tus luchadores.
es.После боя: нанесите 1 урон каждому враже: Después del combate: inflige 1 daño a cada luchador enemigo adyacente al Kraken. Si no se hizo daño de esta manera, tu oponente descarta 1 carta.
es.Во время боя: если противник, участвующи: Durante el combate: si el luchador contrario no comparte zonas con el Kraken, el valor de esta carta es 5.
es.После боя: противник может сбросить 1 ка: Después del combate: Tu oponente puede descartar 1 carta. Si no es así, coloca el Kraken en cualquier espacio.
es.После боя: разместите своего бойца на св: Después del combate: Coloca a tu luchador en cualquier espacio de su zona. Luego, si estás adyacente a un luchador contrario, puedes resolver los efectos posteriores al combate de esta carta nuevamente.
es.После боя: если вы выиграли, разместите: Después del combate: si ganaste, coloca al luchador contrario en un espacio que no comparta zonas con tu luchador.
es.Эффекты этой карты нельзя отменить. Во в: Los efectos de esta carta no se pueden cancelar. Durante el combate: Disminuye el valor de esta carta por la cantidad de otros luchadores en la zona del Kraken.
es.Кракен — огромный боец с дальностью атак: El Kraken es un gran luchador. Además de su alcance normal, puede atacar a los luchadores enemigos adyacentes a cualquiera de sus Tentáculos.
es.После боя: если вы выиграли, нанесите 2: Después del combate: Si ganaste, inflige 2 daños al luchador contrario.
es.Разыгрывается лицом вверх. Можете исполь: Juega boca arriba. Puedes jugar esta carta como un ataque a distancia. Después del combate: Descarta la pila de Carga.
es.Во время боя: можете усилить эту карту к: Durante el combate: Puedes IMPULSAR esta carta. Después del combate: Inflige 1 daño a cada luchador enemigo adyacente a Godzilla.
es.Переместите Годзиллу на расстояние до 1: Mueve Godzilla hasta 1 espacio. Roba 1 carta. Gana 1 acción.
es.После боя: возьмите 1 карту. Затем, если: Después del combate: Roba 1 carta. Luego, si ya has atacado este turno, tu oponente descarta 1 carta.
es.Выберите противника. Он может сбросить 1: Elige un oponente. Pueden descartar 1 carta. Luego, Godzilla recupera una salud igual al valor de BOOST de la carta superior de su pila de descarte.
es.Противник добавляет к этой карте один эф: Tu oponente añade 1 efecto a esta carta: inmediatamente, cancela todos los efectos en la carta de tu oponente; O después del combate, gana 1 acción.
es.Возьмите 2 карты. Разместите Годзиллу на: Roba 2 cartas. Coloca a Godzilla en cualquier espacio de su zona.
es.Нанесите 1 урон каждому вражескому бойцу: Inflige 1 daño a cada luchador enemigo adyacente a Godzilla. Busca una carta en tu mazo y agrégala a tu mano. Baraja tu mazo.
es.После боя: добавьте верхнюю карту своего: Después del combate: Añade la carta superior de tu pila de descarte a la pila de Carga. Si ganaste, añade los 2 primeros.
es.Немедленно: добавьте верхнюю карту сброс: Inmediatamente: agrega la carta superior de la pila de descarte de tu oponente a la pila de Carga.
es.Во время боя: уменьшите весь боевой урон: Durante el combate: Reduce a la mitad el daño de combate infligido a Godzilla, redondeado hacia abajo. Después del combate: si perdiste, baraja la carta superior de tu pila de descarte en tu mazo.
es.После боя: переместите Годзиллу на расст: Después del combate: Mueve a Godzilla hasta 2 espacios. Luego mueve cada luchador en su zona hasta 2 espacios.
es.После боя: если вы выиграли, верните оди: Después del combate: si ganaste, devuelve un plan de tu pila de descarte a tu mano.
es.Годзилла — огромный боец с дальностью ат: Godzilla es un gran luchador. Después de jugar un plan, colóquelo en la pila de Carga. Cuando Godzilla sufre daño, descarta la carta superior de esa pila. Cuando ataque, suma los valores de BOOST de cada carta en la pila de Carga al valor de tu carta.
es.Само это немыслимо. Если бы такое случил: La idea misma es inimaginable. ¡Si ocurriera, no tendríamos ninguna oportunidad! ¿Cómo podríamos combatirlos?
es.Известно, что они нападают на кого угодн: Atacan a coyotes, jabalíes, ciervos, zorros, pumas, manadas de lobos, osos y, finalmente, SERES HUMANOS.
es.Да здравствует король. — Доктор Эмма Рас: Larga vida al rey. — Dra. Emma Russell

alice.name: Алиса
alice.title: Размер имеет значение
alice.ability: Начните большой или маленькой. Большая Алиса получает +2 к атаке картой, маленькая — +1 к защите картой. Размер меняют эффекты карт.

king_arthur.name: Король Артур
king_arthur.title: Меч и магия
king_arthur.ability: Атакуя Артуром, можно заранее добавить усиление второй карты из руки. Если эффекты атаки отменены, усиление теряется. Экскалибур без эффектов сохраняет усиление.

medusa.name: Медуза
medusa.title: Остерегайтесь взгляда
medusa.ability: В начале своего хода можно нанести 1 урон одному вражескому бойцу в зоне Медузы.

sinbad.name: Синдбад
sinbad.title: Семь плаваний
sinbad.ability: При манёвре каждый твой боец может пройти на 1 клетку дальше за каждое плавание в вашем сбросе.

robin_hood.name: Робин Гуд
robin_hood.title: Бей и отступай
robin_hood.ability: После своей атаки можно передвинуть атаковавшего бойца на 0–2 клетки. Способность работает и для разбойников.

bigfoot.name: Бигфут
bigfoot.title: Одиночка по натуре
bigfoot.ability: В конце своего хода можно взять карту, если в зоне Бигфута нет вражеских бойцов.

bruce_lee.name: Брюс Ли
bruce_lee.title: Будь водой
bruce_lee.ability: В конце своего хода можете передвинуть Брюса Ли на 1 клетку.

ingen.name: Роберт Малдун
ingen.title: Охотник InGen
ingen.ability: В начале своего хода можете поставить ловушку на свободную клетку в зоне Малдуна. Враг, входящий на ловушку, останавливается и получает 1 урон; ловушка навсегда убирается. При удалении своей ловушки возьмите 1 карту. Всего 8 ловушек.

raptors.name: Рапторы
raptors.title: Три охотницы
raptors.ability: Три героя по 7 здоровья. Атака раптора картой получает +1 за каждого ДРУГОГО вашего раптора рядом с защищающимся. Вы проигрываете, когда побеждены все три раптора.

muhammad_ali.name: Мухаммед Али
muhammad_ali.title: Порхай как бабочка, жаль как пчела
muhammad_ali.ability: Начните партию в стойке бабочки: Али может атаковать с расстояния до 2 клеток, игнорируя промежуточную клетку и границы зон. В стойке пчелы его атаки получают +2 к силе. После каждой своей атаки при победе смените стойку.

dracula.name: Дракула
dracula.title: Кровожадность
dracula.ability: В начале своего хода можете нанести 1 урон одному бойцу рядом с Дракулой. Если нанесли этот урон, возьмите 1 карту.

sherlock_holmes.name: Шерлок Холмс
sherlock_holmes.title: Великий сыщик
sherlock_holmes.ability: Соперник не может отменять эффекты карт Холмса и доктора Ватсона. Эффекты карт «Любой» можно отменять.

jekyll_hyde.name: Джекил и Хайд
jekyll_hyde.title: Сыворотка
jekyll_hyde.ability: Начните партию доктором Джекилом. В начале своего хода можете превратиться в доктора Джекила или мистера Хайда. В облике Хайда получайте 1 урон после каждого манёвра. Карты с именем Джекила или Хайда доступны только в соответствующем облике.

invisible_man.name: Человек-невидимка
invisible_man.title: Призрак в тумане
invisible_man.ability: После расстановки Невидимки поместите 3 жетона тумана на разные клетки в его зоне. На клетке с туманом его карты защиты получают +1 к силе. Невидимка может перемещаться между клетками с туманом, словно они соседние; правила занятости клеток сохраняются.

buffy.name: Баффи
buffy.title: Истребительница
buffy.ability: Баффи может проходить через клетки с вражескими бойцами, в том числе при перемещении эффектами карт. Перед партией выберите Джайлза или Ксандера и добавьте 5 его карт к 25 общим картам колоды.

angel.name: Ангел
angel.title: Искупление
angel.ability: После атаки Ангела или Фэйт, если вы проиграли бой, возьмите 1 карту.

spike.name: Спайк
spike.title: Тени
spike.ability: В начале своего хода можете поместить жетон тени на любую клетку рядом со Спайком или Друзиллой. Если все 3 жетона уже на поле, вместо этого можете переместить один из них. Жетон может находиться под бойцом или другим жетоном.

willow.name: Уиллоу
willow.title: Тёмная магия
willow.ability: Когда Уиллоу или Тара получает урон, Уиллоу становится Тёмной Уиллоу. В конце своего хода, если Тёмная Уиллоу находится рядом с Тарой, она становится Уиллоу. Оранжевые эффекты выполняются только в облике Тёмной Уиллоу и могут быть отменены.

little_red.name: Красная Шапочка
little_red.title: Не сходи с тропинки
little_red.ability: Ваша корзина — верхняя карта вашего сброса. Выполняйте эффект с символом, совпадающим с корзиной: нож, шкура или цветок. В начале партии корзина пуста и считается звездой. Звезда заменяет любой один символ, но не все сразу.

beowulf.name: Беовульф
beowulf.title: Слава и ярость
beowulf.ability: Начинает с 1 яростью. Каждый раз, когда Беовульф получает урон, он получает 1 ярость, максимум 3. Урон Виглафу ярость не даёт. Трата ярости на эффекты карт всегда добровольна.

houdini.name: Гарри Гудини
houdini.title: Мастер побега
houdini.ability: При усилении манёвра можете поместить Гудини на любую свободную клетку вместо обычного перемещения. Бесс перемещается как обычно. Эффекты «При усилении этой картой» срабатывают немедленно, до сброса карты усиления.

genie.name: Джинн
genie.title: Безграничная сила
genie.ability: В начале своего хода можете сбросить 1 карту и получить 1 дополнительное действие.

achilles.name: Ахиллес
achilles.title: Гнев Ахиллеса
achilles.ability: Когда Патрокл повержен, сбросьте 2 случайные карты. Пока Патрокл повержен, атаки Ахиллеса получают +2; если Ахиллес выигрывает бой, возьмите 1 карту.

bloody_mary.name: Кровавая Мэри
bloody_mary.title: Произнеси трижды
bloody_mary.ability: В начале своего хода, если у вас ровно 3 карты в руке, получите 1 действие.

sun_wukong.name: Сунь Укун
sun_wukong.title: Царь обезьян
sun_wukong.ability: В начале своего хода можете получить 1 урон и призвать клона на свободную клетку рядом с Сунь Укуном. В начале партии клонов на поле нет. Если все трое на поле, переместите одного.

yennenga.name: Йенненга
yennenga.title: Принцесса воинов
yennenga.ability: Когда Йенненга получает урон, можете перенести часть или весь урон на своих лучников в её зоне. Каждый лучник принимает не больше урона, чем у него осталось здоровья.

nikola_tesla.name: Никола Тесла
nikola_tesla.title: Электрическое переполнение
nikola_tesla.ability: Начинает с 1 заряженной катушкой из двух. В конце своего хода может зарядить одну. В начале хода с двумя заряженными катушками наносит по 1 урону всем соседним врагам и может передвинуть каждого на 0–1 клетку. Разрядка катушек на картах добровольна.

dr_jill_trent.name: Доктор Джилл Трент
dr_jill_trent.title: Научный сыщик
dr_jill_trent.ability: В начале хода выберите гаджет. Гипнолучевой бластер: при атаке Джилл, если её напечатанная сила ниже защиты, раскройте верхнюю карту колоды соперника и прибавьте BOOST к атаке. Ультрабиотический тоник: после атаки с большей напечатанной силой восстановите Джилл 1 здоровье. Без защиты напечатанная сила соперника равна 0.

annie_christmas.name: Энни Кристмас
annie_christmas.title: Жемчужное ожерелье
annie_christmas.ability: Атаки Энни получают +2, если её здоровье меньше здоровья защитника. Чарли не получает этот бонус.

golden_bat.name: Золотой Бэт
golden_bat.title: Первый супергерой
golden_bat.ability: Атаки Золотого Бэта получают +2, если он не выполнял манёвр в этом ходу. Перемещение эффектом карты не отменяет бонус. Манёвр без перемещения отменяет бонус.

oda_nobunaga.name: Ода Нобунага
oda_nobunaga.title: Главный стратег
oda_nobunaga.ability: Другие дружественные бойцы в зоне Нобунаги получают +1 к силе сыгранных карт боя, в атаке и защите. Сам Нобунага бонус не получает. Окружение требует соседства врага минимум с двумя бойцами именно под вашим управлением.

tomoe_gozen.name: Томоэ Годзэн
tomoe_gozen.title: Атака при отступлении
tomoe_gozen.ability: Когда вражеский герой покидает зону Томоэ, он получает 1 урон. Действует при движении, переносе, обмене и уходе с поля. Помощники не получают этот урон; движение самой Томоэ его не вызывает.

william_shakespeare.name: Уильям Шекспир
william_shakespeare.title: Пятистопный ямб
william_shakespeare.ability: После атаки или защиты добавьте сыгранную карту в строку. При 10 слогах выполните эффект завершения последней карты и сбросьте строку; при превышении 10 сбросьте её без эффекта. Усиление и обычный сброс в строку не входят. Числа слогов напечатаны на английских сканах.

hamlet.name: Гамлет
hamlet.title: Быть или не быть
hamlet.ability: В начале своего хода выберите «Быть» или «Не быть». «Быть»: при каждом манёвре возьмите 1 дополнительную карту. «Не быть»: нанесите одному своему бойцу 2 урона; атаки Гамлета получают +2. Можно повторять прежний выбор.

titania.name: Титания
titania.title: Магия фей
titania.ability: В начале своего хода, если нет открытых чар, откройте верхние из колоды чар. Они действуют постоянно до сброса эффектом вашей карты. Использованные чары не замешиваются автоматически. Список чар и текущее состояние доступны в окне способности.

the_wayward_sisters.name: Вещие сёстры
the_wayward_sisters.title: Бурлящее варево
the_wayward_sisters.ability: Три героя по 6 здоровья. Все сбрасываемые карты сначала попадают в котёл. После атаки можете сотворить одно заклинание из имеющихся ингредиентов, затем сбросить весь котёл. Нужные сочетания и содержимое котла доступны в окне способности.

geralt_of_rivia.name: Геральт из Ривии
geralt_of_rivia.title: Всегда готов
geralt_of_rivia.ability: До начала партии выберите меч, доспех и зелье. Две копии каждого выбранного снаряжения входят в колоду из 30 карт. Неиспользованное снаряжение в партии не участвует. Постоянный приём остаётся перед вами; новый заменяет предыдущий.

ciri.name: Цири
ciri.title: Неукротимая сила
ciri.ability: Карты Источника отмечены значком. Их эффекты зависят от числа таких карт в вашем сбросе на момент разрешения. Всегда применяется наибольший достигнутый порог. При 7 и более картах Источника в сбросе эффекты всех ваших карт нельзя отменить.

ancient_leshen.name: Древний Леший
ancient_leshen.title: Сердце леса
ancient_leshen.ability: Леший движется на 1 клетку, волки — на 3; усиление прибавляется каждому. Если Леший уже атаковал в этом ходу, его следующие атаки получают +3. Атаки волков не включают этот бонус. Призыв возвращает поверженного волка либо переносит живого, если оба уже на поле.

eredin.name: Эредин
eredin.title: Король Дикой Охоты
eredin.ability: Пока все ваши Всадники повержены, Эредин в ярости: +1 к силе всех ваших карт атаки и защиты, движение — 3. Возвращение Всадника немедленно прекращает ярость. Обычное движение — 2.

philippa.name: Филиппа
philippa.title: На два шага впереди
philippa.ability: В конце своего хода можете добрать карты до 4 в руке. Если согласились, берите всё недостающее число карт; при 4 и более картах способность недоступна.

yennefer_triss.name: Йеннифэр и Трисс
yennefer_triss.title: Чародейки-соперницы
yennefer_triss.ability: До партии выберите главную героиню: 14 ОЗ, другая — помощница с 6 ОЗ. Йеннифэр-героиня может усилить свою атаку на этапе «Сразу»; способность нельзя отменить. Трисс-героиня после своего приёма обязана нанести 2 урона соседнему бойцу, включая дружественного. Способность помощницы не действует.

daredevil.name: Сорвиголова
daredevil.title: Человек без страха
daredevil.ability: В бою при 0–2 картах в руке можно сбросить верхнюю карту колоды и добавить её усиление к силе атаки или защиты. Способность не отменяется. Порядок со своими эффектами «В бою» выбираете вы.

bullseye.name: Меченый
bullseye.title: Идеальная точность
bullseye.ability: Атакует в общей зоне как обычный дальний боец, а также на расстоянии до 5 линий между клетками вне зависимости от зон.

elektra.name: Электра
elektra.title: Смерть — лишь начало
elektra.ability: Первое поражение Электры убирает её и Руку с поля без выбывания. В начале следующего своего хода она воскресает с 9 ОЗ: сброс замешивается в оставшуюся колоду, рука сохраняется. Электра и 4 ниндзя размещаются в разных зонах. Затем действуют дополнительные эффекты воскрешения.

luke_cage.name: Люк Кейдж
luke_cage.title: Непробиваемый
luke_cage.ability: Люк уменьшает входящий боевой урон на 2, включая защиту без карты. Если урона нет, он побеждает в бою. Способность не защищает Мисти и не уменьшает урон эффектов или истощения.

moon_knight.name: Лунный рыцарь
moon_knight.title: Marvel
moon_knight.ability: Три личности. В начале хода Лунный рыцарь движется до 2 клеток. Хонсу: +2 к атаке и защита от небоевого урона. Мистер Найт: +1 к защите. В конце хода обязательная смена по кругу.

ghost_rider.name: Призрачный гонщик
ghost_rider.title: Marvel
ghost_rider.ability: Начинает с 5 единиц адского пламени (предел 0–5). При манёвре можно потратить 1: движение ровно до 4 без усиления, сквозь врагов, по 1 урону каждому пройденному врагу.

ms_marvel.name: Мисс Марвел
ms_marvel.title: Marvel
ms_marvel.ability: В начале хода можно передвинуться до 1 клетки. Ближняя атака достигает цели на расстоянии до 2 линий независимо от зон.

winter_soldier.name: Зимний солдат
winter_soldier.title: Marvel
winter_soldier.ability: Эффекты карт Зимнего солдата нельзя отменить. «Красная комната» даёт противникам преимущества, пока её не отключит «Парень по имени Баки».

alice.name: Alice
alice.title: Size matters
alice.ability: Start big or small. Big Alice gets +2 to card attacks; small Alice gets +1 to card defenses. Card effects change her size.

king_arthur.name: King Arthur
king_arthur.title: Sword and sorcery
king_arthur.ability: When Arthur attacks, you may boost the attack with another card from your hand. If the attack effects are canceled, this boost is lost. Effect-free Excalibur keeps the boost.

medusa.name: Medusa
medusa.title: Beware the gaze
medusa.ability: At the start of your turn, you may deal 1 damage to an enemy fighter in Medusa's zone.

sinbad.name: Sinbad
sinbad.title: Seven voyages
sinbad.ability: When maneuvering, each of your fighters may move 1 extra space for each voyage in your discard.

robin_hood.name: Robin Hood
robin_hood.title: Hit and run
robin_hood.ability: After you attack, you may move the attacking fighter up to 2 spaces. This ability also works for Outlaws.

bigfoot.name: Bigfoot
bigfoot.title: A natural loner
bigfoot.ability: At the end of your turn, you may draw a card if there are no enemy fighters in Bigfoot's zone.

bruce_lee.name: Bruce Lee
bruce_lee.title: Be Like Water
bruce_lee.ability: At the end of your turn, you may move Bruce Lee 1 space.

ingen.name: Robert Muldoon
ingen.title: InGen hunter
ingen.ability: At the start of your turn, you may place a trap in an empty space in Muldoon’s zone. An enemy entering a trap stops and takes 1 damage; the trap is permanently removed. When one of your traps is removed, draw 1 card. You have 8 traps in total.

raptors.name: Raptors
raptors.title: Three huntresses
raptors.ability: Three heroes with 7 health each. A Raptor’s card attack gets +1 for each of your OTHER Raptors adjacent to the defender. You lose when all three Raptors are defeated.

muhammad_ali.name: Muhammad Ali
muhammad_ali.title: Float Like a Butterfly, Sting Like a Bee
muhammad_ali.ability: Begin the game with your stance on Float Like a Butterfly. After you attack, if you won the combat, change stances. Float Like a Butterfly: you can attack from up to 2 spaces away, ignoring the space in between and zone boundaries. Sting Like a Bee: add +2 to your attacks.

dracula.name: Dracula
dracula.title: Bloodthirsty
dracula.ability: At the start of your turn, you may deal 1 damage to a fighter adjacent to Dracula. If you do, draw a card.

sherlock_holmes.name: Sherlock Holmes
sherlock_holmes.title: The Great Detective
sherlock_holmes.ability: Effects on HOLMES and DR. WATSON cards cannot be canceled by an opponent. Effects on ANY cards can be canceled.

jekyll_hyde.name: Jekyll & Hyde
jekyll_hyde.title: The Serum
jekyll_hyde.ability: Start the game as Dr. Jekyll. At the start of your turn, you may transform into Dr. Jekyll or Mr. Hyde. While Mr. Hyde: after you maneuver, take 1 damage. Cards named for Jekyll or Hyde can only be played in the matching form.

invisible_man.name: Invisible Man
invisible_man.title: Ghost in the Mist
invisible_man.ability: At the start of the game, after placing Invisible Man, place 3 fog tokens in separate spaces in his zone. While Invisible Man is on a space with a fog token, add 1 to the value of his defense cards. He may move between two spaces with fog tokens as if they were adjacent.

buffy.name: Buffy
buffy.title: The Slayer
buffy.ability: Buffy may move through spaces containing opposing fighters (including when she is moved by effects). Before the game, choose Giles or Xander and add their 5 cards to the 25 shared cards in the deck.

angel.name: Angel
angel.title: Redemption
angel.ability: After Angel or Faith attacks, if you lost the combat, draw 1 card.

spike.name: Spike
spike.title: Shadows
spike.ability: At the start of your turn, you may place a Shadow token in any space adjacent to Spike or Drusilla. If all 3 tokens are already on the board, you may move one instead. A token may share a space with a fighter or another token.

willow.name: Willow
willow.title: Dark Magic
willow.ability: When Willow or Tara is dealt damage, Willow becomes Dark Willow. At the end of your turn, if Dark Willow is adjacent to Tara, she becomes Willow. Orange effects resolve only as Dark Willow and can be canceled.

little_red.name: Little Red Riding Hood
little_red.title: Never Leave the Path
little_red.ability: Your basket is the top card of your discard pile. Resolve effects with its matching symbol: knife, pelt, or flower. Before any card is discarded, the starting Basket counts as a star. A star replaces any one symbol, not all three at once.

beowulf.name: Beowulf
beowulf.title: Glory and Rage
beowulf.ability: Start with 1 Rage. Each time Beowulf is dealt damage, gain 1 Rage, up to 3. Damage to Wiglaf does not grant Rage. Spending Rage on card effects is always optional.

houdini.name: Harry Houdini
houdini.title: Escape Artist
houdini.ability: When you BOOST a maneuver, you may place Houdini in any empty space instead of moving. Bess moves normally. BOOSTED WITH effects resolve immediately, before discarding the boost card.

genie.name: The Genie
genie.title: Infinite Power
genie.ability: At the start of your turn, you may discard 1 card to gain 1 action.

achilles.name: Achilles
achilles.title: Achilles’ Rage
achilles.ability: When Patroclus is defeated, discard 2 random cards. While he is defeated, Achilles’ attacks gain +2; when Achilles wins combat, draw 1 card.

bloody_mary.name: Bloody Mary
bloody_mary.title: Speak Three Times
bloody_mary.ability: At the start of your turn, if you have exactly 3 cards in hand, gain 1 action.

sun_wukong.name: Sun Wukong
sun_wukong.title: The Monkey King
sun_wukong.ability: At the start of your turn, you may take 1 damage to summon a Clone in an empty adjacent space. Start with no Clones on the board. If all three are on the board, relocate one.

yennenga.name: Yennenga
yennenga.title: Warrior Princess
yennenga.ability: When Yennenga takes damage, you may assign some or all of it to her Archers in her zone. An Archer cannot take more damage than its remaining health.

nikola_tesla.name: Nikola Tesla
nikola_tesla.title: Electrical Overflow
nikola_tesla.ability: Start with 1 of 2 coils charged. At the end of your turn, you may charge one. At the start of your turn with both charged, deal 1 damage to each adjacent enemy and you may move each up to 1 space. Discharging coils for card effects is optional.

dr_jill_trent.name: Dr. Jill Trent
dr_jill_trent.title: Science Sleuth
dr_jill_trent.ability: Choose a gadget at the start of your turn. Hypnoray Blaster: when Jill attacks with a lower printed value than the defense, reveal the opponent’s top deck card and add its BOOST to her attack. Ultrabiotic Tonic: after Jill attacks with a higher printed value, she recovers 1 health. No defense has printed value 0.

annie_christmas.name: Annie Christmas
annie_christmas.title: Necklace of Pearls
annie_christmas.ability: Annie’s attacks gain +2 if her health is lower than the defender’s. Charlie does not receive this bonus.

golden_bat.name: Golden Bat
golden_bat.title: The First Superhero
golden_bat.ability: Golden Bat’s attacks gain +2 if he has not maneuvered this turn. Movement from card effects does not remove this bonus. A maneuver without moving does remove it.

oda_nobunaga.name: Oda Nobunaga
oda_nobunaga.title: Master Strategist
oda_nobunaga.ability: Other friendly fighters in Oda’s zone add +1 to their played combat cards, on attack and defense. Oda does not benefit. Flanking requires two adjacent fighters under your own control.

tomoe_gozen.name: Tomoe Gozen
tomoe_gozen.title: Attack of Opportunity
tomoe_gozen.ability: When an opposing hero leaves Tomoe’s zone, deal 1 damage to that hero. Applies to movement, placement, swaps and leaving the board. Sidekicks are unaffected. Moving Tomoe does not trigger it.

william_shakespeare.name: William Shakespeare
william_shakespeare.title: Iambic Pentameter
william_shakespeare.ability: After attacking or defending, add your played card to your line. At exactly 10 syllables, resolve the last card’s completion effect and discard the line. Above 10, discard it without an effect. Boosts and other discards do not enter the line. Use the printed English syllable counts.

hamlet.name: Hamlet
hamlet.title: The Question
hamlet.ability: At the start of your turn choose TO BE or NOT TO BE. TO BE draws one extra card with each maneuver. NOT TO BE deals 2 damage to one of your fighters and adds +2 to Hamlet’s attacks. You may repeat the previous choice.

titania.name: Titania
titania.title: Fairy Magic
titania.ability: At the start of your turn, if you have no active glamour, reveal the top glamour. Its effect remains active until discarded by one of your cards. Discarded glamours are not automatically reshuffled. View the ability panel for all glamours and their state.

the_wayward_sisters.name: The Wayward Sisters
the_wayward_sisters.title: Bubbling Brew
the_wayward_sisters.ability: Three heroes with 6 health each. All discarded cards enter your cauldron first. After attacking, you may cast one spell using its required ingredients, then discard the entire cauldron. The ability panel shows the recipes and cauldron cards.

geralt_of_rivia.name: Geralt of Rivia
geralt_of_rivia.title: Always Prepared
geralt_of_rivia.ability: Before the match, choose a sword, armor and potion. Two copies of each enter your 30-card deck. Unselected gear is not used. An ongoing scheme stays face up; a new one replaces the previous one.

ciri.name: Ciri
ciri.title: Uncontainable Power
ciri.ability: Source cards have an icon. Their effects depend on the number of Source cards in your discard pile when resolving. Always use the highest attained threshold. With at least 7 Source cards in your discard pile, effects on all your cards cannot be canceled.

ancient_leshen.name: Ancient Leshen
ancient_leshen.title: Heart of the Forest
ancient_leshen.ability: Leshen moves 1, Wolves move 3; boosts add to each. If Leshen already attacked this turn, his subsequent attacks gain +3. Wolf attacks do not enable this bonus. Summoning returns a defeated Wolf, or relocates a living one if both are on the board.

eredin.name: Eredin
eredin.title: King of the Wild Hunt
eredin.ability: While all your Red Riders are defeated, Eredin is ENRAGED: +1 to all your attack and defense cards, move 3. Returning a Rider immediately ends Enraged. Normal move 2.

philippa.name: Philippa
philippa.title: Two Steps Ahead
philippa.ability: At the end of your turn, you may draw until you have 4 cards. If accepted, draw the full missing number; unavailable with 4 or more cards.

yennefer_triss.name: Yennefer & Triss
yennefer_triss.title: Rival Sorceresses
yennefer_triss.ability: Before play choose your hero (14 health); the other is a sidekick (6). Hero Yennefer may boost her own attack during Immediately; this ability cannot be canceled. After hero Triss plays a scheme, she must deal 2 damage to an adjacent fighter, including friendly fighters. The sidekick ability is inactive.

daredevil.name: Daredevil
daredevil.title: Man Without Fear
daredevil.ability: With 0–2 hand cards during combat, optionally discard your deck’s top card and add its boost to attack or defense. This ability cannot be canceled. Choose its order with your other during-combat effects.

bullseye.name: Bullseye
bullseye.title: Perfect Aim
bullseye.ability: Attack in a shared zone as usual, or across up to 5 links regardless of zones.

elektra.name: Elektra
elektra.title: Death Is Only the Beginning
elektra.ability: Elektra’s first defeat temporarily removes her and all Hand. At her next turn she returns with 9 health. Shuffle her discards into her remaining deck, keeping her hand. Place her and four ninjas in separate zones. Resurrection effects now apply.

luke_cage.name: Luke Cage
luke_cage.title: Unbreakable
luke_cage.ability: Reduce Luke’s incoming combat damage by 2, even without a defense card. Zero damage means he wins combat. Misty, effect damage and exhaustion do not receive this reduction.

moon_knight.name: Moon Knight
moon_knight.title: Marvel
moon_knight.ability: Three personalities. At the start of Moon Knight's turn, he moves up to 2 squares. Khonsu: +2 attack and protection from non-combat damage. Mr. Knight: +1 defense. At the end of the turn there is a mandatory change in a circle.

ghost_rider.name: Ghost Rider
ghost_rider.title: Marvel
ghost_rider.ability: Starts with 5 Hellfire (limit 0-5). When maneuvering, you can spend 1: move exactly up to 4 without boosting, through enemies, 1 damage to each enemy passed.

ms_marvel.name: Ms. Marvel
ms_marvel.title: Marvel
ms_marvel.ability: At the beginning of the turn, you can move up to 1 square. Melee attacks reach targets up to 2 lines away, regardless of zones.

winter_soldier.name: Winter Soldier
winter_soldier.title: Marvel
winter_soldier.ability: The effects of Winter Soldier cards cannot be canceled. The Red Room gives enemies an advantage until it is disabled by A Guy Named Bucky.

t_rex.name: Tyrannosaurus
t_rex.title: Jurassic Park
t_rex.ability: Large fighter: occupies up to two cells, attacks up to two lines from any of them. At the end of his turn, he draws a card.

dr_ellie_sattler.name: Ellie Sattler
dr_ellie_sattler.title: Jurassic Park
dr_ellie_sattler.ability: After moving Sattler or Malcolm, place an insight token on the end space. Stock - 5 tokens; can be folded. The room does not give a token.

she_hulk.name: She-Hulk
she_hulk.title: Marvel
she_hulk.ability: At the beginning of the turn, you can discard a card and deal buff damage to the selected fighter in your zone.

spider_man.name: Spider-Man
spider_man.title: Marvel
spider_man.ability: Before choosing to defend against an attack, Spider-Man learns the printed strength of the attack card.

doctor_strange.name: Doctor Strange
doctor_strange.title: Marvel
doctor_strange.ability: After a battle in which Strange has played a card, you can deal 1 damage to him, put that card on the bottom of the deck, and draw the card.

cloak_and_dagger.name: Cloak and Dagger
cloak_and_dagger.title: Marvel
cloak_and_dagger.ability: Two heroes with separate health bars of 8. After an attack with 2 or more combat damage, Cloak forces the opponent to discard a card, Dagger receives an action.

svyatogor.name: FAN · Svyatogor
svyatogor.title: At the Dawn of the Russian Land
svyatogor.ability:
Svyatogor is a large fighter (he can attack from 2 spaces away).

MOTHER EARTH CANNOT BEAR HIM
Whenever you maneuver, Svyatogor takes 1 damage.
svyatogor.quote: O you brave and valiant young warrior! Death has come for me here, and I cannot escape it.

mikula.name: FAN · Mikula Selyaninovich
mikula.title: At the Dawn of the Russian Land
mikula.ability:
At the start of the game, place the pouch of earthly weight in your zone.

While Mikula is in the pouch’s space or adjacent to it, effects marked ⊗ are active. These effects cannot be canceled.

If an opposing fighter is in the pouch’s space, add 2 to the value of their attacks. Before each attack they make from that space, they lose 1 health.
mikula.quote: And if you’d like to test your strength, then go ahead—try lifting this pack of mine.

black_panther.name: Black Panther
black_panther.title: Marvel
black_panther.ability:
VIBRANIUM SUIT
Whenever you BOOST, draw 1 card.
Cards stored in your VIBRANIUM SUIT can only be used to BOOST.

black_widow.name: Black Widow
black_widow.title: Marvel
black_widow.ability:
MISSION READY
Before drawing your starting hand, add THE MOSCOW PROTOCOL card to your hand.
Then, shuffle your deck and draw 5 cards. (Your starting hand is 6 cards instead of 5.)

squirrel_girl.name: Squirrel Girl
squirrel_girl.title: Marvel
squirrel_girl.ability:
GO NUTS!
At the start of your turn, summon a squirrel in a space adjacent to Squirrel Girl.
Squirrels are small fighters. Do not start with any squirrels on the board.

deadpool.name: Deadpool
deadpool.title: Marvel
deadpool.ability:
After you attack, Deadpool recovers 1 health.

Also, if your opponent's real name is Logan, all your attacks are +5.

blackbeard.name: Blackbeard
blackbeard.title: Battle of Legends, Volume Three
blackbeard.ability:
PRIVATEER TURNED PIRATE
Start the game with 1 doubloon in the treasury, you have the other 2.
- At the start of your turn, you may pay 1 doubloon to gain 1 action.
- When Blackbeard takes combat damage, pay 1 doubloon.

BLACKBEARD'S DOUBLOONS
Doubloons that Blackbeard doesn't have are kept in the Treasury.

Blackbeard pays a doubloon to the Treasury when he takes combat damage. He may also pay a doubloon at the start of his turn to gain an extra action.

The effects on many of Blackbeard's cards can be ignored by paying a ransom. Any opponent can pay the amount of doubloons shown at the end of an effect to ignore that effect. These doubloons are taken from the Treasury and given to Blackbeard.

loki.name: Loki
loki.title: Battle of Legends, Volume Three
loki.ability:
MISCHIEF-MONGER
After you play a TRICK, put that card into your opponent's hand instead of your discard pile.
If an opponent discards a TRICK from their hand, return that card to your hand or the top of your deck.
Add +1 to your move value for each
TRICK in your opponents hands.

chupacabra.name: Chupacabra
chupacabra.title: Battle of Legends, Volume Three
chupacabra.ability:
THE HUNGER
After you attack, you may draw a card.

pandora.name: Pandora
pandora.title: Battle of Legends, Volume Three
pandora.ability:
PANDORA'S BOX
Do not start with any Kakodamons on the board.
At the start of your turn, open Pandora's Box.

Pandora's Box is a deck of seven cards called MISERIES.
When you open Pandora's Box, reveal the top card and resolve its effect if any). You may keep revealing and resolving additional cards, one at a time, until you choose to stop.
If there are three or more total feathers on revealed cards, you must stop revealing, then Pandora takes 1 damage for each revealed MISERY.
At the end of your turn, shuffle all revealed MISERIES back into
Pandora's Box.

leonardo.name: Leonardo
leonardo.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
leonardo.ability:
Team Tactics
At the start of your turn, move any fighter up to 1 space.

donatello.name: Donatello
donatello.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
donatello.ability:
Inventive
When you maneuver, you may draw 2 cards instead of 1. If you do, put a card in your hand on the bottom of your deck.

After you play an invention, tuck it under this card. For the rest of the game, its invention bonus applies.

michelangelo.name: Michelangelo
michelangelo.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
michelangelo.ability:
Pizza Party
After your attack or scheme, draw 1 card.

Your starting and maximum hand size is 3.

raphael.name: Raphael
raphael.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
raphael.ability:
Anger Issues
On each of your turns, the first time you lose combat, gain 1 action.

george_washington.name: George Washington
george_washington.title: Stars and Stripes
george_washington.ability:
ESPIONAGE
You start with 4 ruse tokens.
When you attack, you may use a ruse token, placing it next to the card.
Before your opponent chooses whether or not to defend, they may discard 1 random card to remove the ruse token.

rosie_the_riveter.name: Rosie The Riveter
rosie_the_riveter.title: Stars and Stripes
rosie_the_riveter.ability:
FREEDOM XK-II MECH SUIT
You have 4 upgrade tokens. Start the game with all 4 inactive.
At the start of your turn, activate an upgrade.
At the end of your turn, if all 4 upgrades are active, deactivate all of them.

john_henry.name: John Henry
john_henry.title: Stars and Stripes
john_henry.ability:
STEEL-DRIVING MAN

You have 10 track tokens.
At the start of your turn, summon a track token in a space in John Henry's zone.
When you move John Henry, do not count spaces with track tokens.

wyatt_earp.name: Wyatt Earp
wyatt_earp.title: Stars and Stripes
wyatt_earp.ability:
SHOWDOWN
After you attack and win combat, choose one effect. You cannot choose the same effect twice in a turn.
• draw 1 card
• gain 1 free action to attack
• move your fighter up to 1 space

hellboy.name: Hellboy
hellboy.title: Hellboy
hellboy.ability:
AHH CRAP!
Start as OCCULT DETECTIVE. With 6 or more destiny cards in your discard pile, switch to ANUNG UN RAMA. With 5 or fewer, switch back.

OCCULT DETECTIVE: At the start of your turn, if Hellboy is in an opponent’s starting space, you may draw 2 cards.

ANUNG UN RAMA: Add +2 to Hellboy’s attacks. At the start of your turn, discard 1 card. Move Hellboy up to its BOOST value. These bonuses do not apply to Lobster Johnson.

abe_sapien.name: Abe Sapien
abe_sapien.title: Hellboy
abe_sapien.ability:
UNCANNY INTUITION
Your two Intuition tokens start inactive. When Abe deals combat damage to an adjacent fighter, activate a token. When Abe is attacked, if you have an active token, deactivate it, draw 1 card, and play the attack face up before defense is chosen. This ability does not apply to the B.P.R.D. Agents.

liz_sherman.name: Liz Sherman
liz_sherman.title: Hellboy
liz_sherman.ability:
WILDFIRE
Whenever you discard a burning card from your hand or deck, reveal it and put it into your hand. This does not apply to played cards or discarding down to your hand limit.
At the start of your turn, discard the bottom card of your deck. If it is a burning card, deal 1 damage to another fighter in Liz’s zone. Otherwise, move Liz up to 2 spaces.

baba_yaga.name: Baba Yaga
baba_yaga.title: Hellboy
baba_yaga.ability:
FATEFUL BARGAINS
If Baba Yaga and Koschei share a zone and Baba Yaga would take effect damage, you may have Koschei take all that damage instead. This does not redirect combat or exhaustion damage. Bound in Blood separately allows Koschei to take combat damage.
You may have one active ongoing scheme. A pact is discarded when Baba Yaga takes 2 or more combat damage in one combat.

shredder.name: Shredder
shredder.title: TMNT: Shredder vs Krang
shredder.ability:
MASTER OF THE CLAN
At the start of your turn, deploy a Foot soldier to a path adjacent to a friendly fighter.

You may attack opposing fighters adjacent to Foot soldiers.

If an opponents boosts their maneuver, they may remove any Foot soldier their hero moves through.

krang.name: Krang
krang.title: TMNT: Shredder vs Krang
krang.ability:
DOOOOOM!
Krang has 3 doomsday machines.
Start with one machine active.

After you roll the Dice of Ultimate Destruction, you can deactivate an active machine to reroll the die.

Add +1 to your move value for each active machine.

birds.name: FAN · The Birds
birds.title: FAN · Giants versus Nature
birds.ability: Six Birds, each with 2 health. During setup place each additional Bird adjacent to another Bird. After your first attack of each action, you may discard 1 card to make a SWARM bonus attack. During SWARM, draw 1 card; its value equals the number of Birds adjacent to the opposing fighter.
birds.quote: The very concept is unimaginable. Why, if it happened, we wouldn’t have a chance! How could we possibly hope to fight them?

moose.name: FAN · Moose
moose.title: FAN · Giants versus Nature
moose.ability: The Moose is a large fighter. He can only attack adjacent opposing fighters. When moving, his head cannot enter his tail’s space. During combat when attacking, if the opposing fighter is adjacent to his head, add 2 to your card’s value.
moose.quote: They’ve been known to attack anything, from coyotes, wild boars, deer, red foxes, cougars, wolf packs, bears, and finally, HUMANS.

kraken.name: FAN · The Kraken
kraken.title: FAN · Giants versus Nature
kraken.ability: The Kraken is a large fighter. In addition to his normal reach, he may attack opposing fighters adjacent to any of his Tentacles.

godzilla.name: FAN · Godzilla
godzilla.title: FAN · Giants versus Nature
godzilla.ability: Godzilla is a large fighter. After playing a scheme, put it in the Charge-Up pile. When Godzilla takes damage, discard the top card of that pile. When he attacks, add the BOOST values of every card in the Charge-Up pile to your card’s value.
